edges.evidence: John Malkovich | John Gavin Malkovich (born December 9, 1953) is an American actor, director, and producer.  He has appeared in more than 70 films.  For his roles in "Places in the Heart" and "In the Line of Fire", he received Academy Award nominations.  He has also appeared in films such as "Empire of the Sun", "The Killing Fields", "Con Air", "Of Mice and Men", "Rounders", "Ripley's Game", "Knockaround Guys", "Being John Malkovich", "Shadow of the Vampire", "Burn After Reading", "RED", "Mulholland Falls", "Dangerous Liaisons", and "Warm Bodies", as well as producing films such as "Ghost World", "Juno", and "The Perks of Being a Wallflower".
